mechanism: HeavyColorClass partitions a finite weighted family by colors and selects a maximum-mass class. WeightBinning discards weights below total/(2n), losing at most half the finite positive total; every retained weight lies between threshold and total, hence O(log n) dyadic bands suffice independently of original weight spread. One maximal-mass band retains at least total/(2L). TCore deletes whole deficient fibers from a single current edge set until all nonempty fibers meet their coordinate thresholds.
proof_checks: WeightBinning explicitly proves n>0, finite nonzero2n, positive finite threshold, total/2 finite for additive cancellation, complete/disjoint half-open bands and positive selected-band level. TCore proves other-coordinate images only shrink, the selected-coordinate image loses exactly one parent, capacity drops by at leastTk, and each nonempty bad-fiber deletion strictly decreases edge cardinality. Removed-edge sets are disjointly charged through strong induction. HeavyColorClass uses no division and allows infinite color mass.
